newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Yasin plans to meet top IMF official - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Yasin plans to meet top IMF official - agency.

text.p: Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Friday he would soon meet a top International Monetary Fund official for talks on Russia's $10 billion loan agreement with the Fund, RIA news agency reported.
It quoted Yasin as saying he would meet IMF First Deputy Managing Director Stanley Fischer "for a re-assessment of events in the Russian economy and to take account of new realities."
An IMF mission is in Moscow to assess whether to recommend the release of a tranche of the loan, effectively delayed last month because of concern over the low level of tax collection.
